• Credit Limit 250 - 2,499 JOD.
• Capital Rewards earn 0.25 points for each 1 JOD spent and redeem them as cashback on the collected points up to 4.25% based on customer segment.

sections.content:
A highly exclusive credit card, offered by invitation to Private Banking clients. Benefits:
• Credit Limit 15,000– 50,000 JOD.
• Capital Rewards earn 0.75 points for each 1 JOD spent and redeem them as cashback on the collected points up to 4.25% based on customer segment
• Easy Payment Plan Install your purchases with 0% interest for up to 36 months at accredited merchants’ network or 0.75% per month fees on merchant outside our network
• Fast Track Service in some countries
• Airport lounge access: Unlimited access to 1300+ airport lounges in more than 500 cities all around the world for yourself and one guest by downloading VISA AIRPORT COMPANION subject to meeting a minimum spend of 1 USD as an international transaction either a POS machine or eCommerce transaction annually
• The Cardholders will be initially assigned two (2) complimentary visits to utilize across Cardholder and guests (max 1 guest per visit) each year.
• Global Emergency Assistance: If you have lost your Visa card, Visa may be able to block your account, send a replacement and provide emergency cash.
• 24/7 Complementary Lifestyle Concierge: 24-hour concierge provides a personal service to Visa Infinite privilege cardholders, taking care of all the details so they can simply take their seats and enjoy.
• Chauffeur Service Airport Pick and Drop: Enjoy complimentary private chauffeur airport pick-up or drop-off service Across 80+ cities in over 35+ countries (excluding GCC). Cardholders booking first or business class airfare through the VIP Concierge receive a complimentary one-way ride in a luxury car. Advance booking 48 hours prior is required, with conditions on waiting times and mileage. Simply call the VIP Concierge to book and experience seamless, door-to-door luxury travel .
• Airport meet and assist: Enjoy a warm welcome wherever you travel with unlimited complimentary airport Meet & Assist services at 16 key destinations worldwide. Cardholders also receive 25% discounts for their guests.
• Worldwide Hotel Program: Enjoy elite benefits at luxury hotels worldwide when booking through Visa Concierge. Get complimentary room upgrades, early check-in and late check-out, daily breakfast for two, $100 spa or dining credit.
• Luxury Villa Rentals: Discover the ultimate in private luxury with Lacure Premium Villas, a curated collection of exclusive villas in scenic global destinations. Enjoy personalized service, a $500 credit toward extras like a private chef, butler, chauffeur. and a 10% discount when booking with your Visa Infinite Privilege card.
• VIP Dining Experience: Indulge in exclusive culinary experiences at Michelin- selected and premium restaurants and enjoy guaranteed discounts of up to 50% with discreet billing and unlimited guests — no promo codes needed.
• Yacht Program: Discover the world of luxury yachting with Camper & Nicholsons, offering expert advice and bespoke experiences worldwide, from the Mediterranean to the Indian Ocean. Benefit from a €5,000 credit on charters over €100,000, usable for dining, local excursions, entertainment, wellness, and more.
• Cruise Program: Experience luxury cruising with Visa Infinite Privilege, enjoying bespoke voyages across top destinations like the Mediterranean, Europe, Caribbean, and Asia. Benefits include one complimentary shore excursion per person, up to $250 shipboard credit.
• Travel Insurance Cardholder can issue their travel insurance policy through card our website, through enter Visa Card Benefits link
• Extended Warranty: Adds real value to your Visa Infinite privilege card. Provides up to 12 months’ additional coverage beyond the manufacturer’s warranty, with protection up to $5,000 per item and a $25,000 annual limit.
• Buyers Protection : Covers theft and damage of eligible new purchases within 365 days of purchase, with coverage up to $10,000 per claim and a $25,000 annual limit.
• Collison Damage Waiver (CDW): A cardholder is liable to reimburse a licensed rental agency for costs arising from material damage to a Rental Vehicle during the period of hire Provides cover Rental Vehicle worth up to $170,000 and rented for a maximum of 31 consecutive days.
• Fraudulent Card Misuse Protection: All Visa Infinite Privilege cards will be protected against unauthorized transactions or fraudulent use of their card by unrelated third parties. This insurance benefit will provide reimbursement of up to USD 3,000 per occurrence with a USD 5,000 annual aggregate limit for Visa Infinite Privilege Cardholders.

blocks.text: A credit card is a payment instrument issued by a bank or financial institution that allows cardholders to borrow money up to a predefined credit limit. The borrowed amount can be repaid in full or partially.

24/7 Complementary Lifestyle Concierge: 24-hour concierge provides a personal service to Visa Infinite privilege cardholders, taking care of all the details so they can simply take their seats and enjoy.

Chauffeur Service Airport Pick and Drop: Enjoy complimentary private chauffeur airport pick-up or drop-off service Across 80+ cities in over 35+ countries (excluding GCC). Cardholders booking first or business class airfare through the VIP Concierge receive a complimentary one-way ride in a luxury car. Advance booking 48 hours prior is required, with conditions on waiting times and mileage. Simply call the VIP Concierge to book and experience seamless, door-to-door luxury travel .

Airport meet and assist: Enjoy a warm welcome wherever you travel with unlimited complimentary airport Meet & Assist services at 16 key destinations worldwide. Cardholders also receive 25% discounts for their guests.

Worldwide Hotel Program: Enjoy elite benefits at luxury hotels worldwide when booking through Visa Concierge. Get complimentary room upgrades, early check-in and late check-out, daily breakfast for two, $100 spa or dining credit.

Luxury Villa Rentals: Discover the ultimate in private luxury with Lacure Premium Villas, a curated collection of exclusive villas in scenic global destinations. Enjoy personalized service, a $500 credit toward extras like a private chef, butler, chauffeur. and a 10% discount when booking with your Visa Infinite Privilege card.

VIP Dining Experience: Indulge in exclusive culinary experiences at Michelin- selected and premium restaurants and enjoy guaranteed discounts of up to 50% with discreet billing and unlimited guests — no promo codes needed.

Yacht Program: Discover the world of luxury yachting with Camper & Nicholsons, offering expert advice and bespoke experiences worldwide, from the Mediterranean to the Indian Ocean. Benefit from a €5,000 credit on charters over €100,000, usable for dining, local excursions, entertainment, wellness, and more.

Cruise Program: Experience luxury cruising with Visa Infinite Privilege, enjoying bespoke voyages across top destinations like the Mediterranean, Europe, Caribbean, and Asia. Benefits include one complimentary shore excursion per person, up to $250 shipboard credit.
Travel Insurance Cardholder can issue their travel insurance policy through card our website, through enter Visa Card Benefits link

Extended Warranty: Adds real value to your Visa Infinite privilege card. Provides up to 12 months’ additional coverage beyond the manufacturer’s warranty, with protection up to $5,000 per item and a $25,000 annual limit.
Buyers Protection : Covers theft and damage of eligible new purchases within 365 days of purchase, with coverage up to $10,000 per claim and a $25,000 annual limit.

Collison Damage Waiver (CDW): A cardholder is liable to reimburse a licensed rental agency for costs arising from material damage to a Rental Vehicle during the period of hire Provides cover Rental Vehicle worth up to $170,000 and rented for a maximum of 31 consecutive days.

Fraudulent Card Misuse Protection: All Visa Infinite Privilege cards will be protected against unauthorized transactions or fraudulent use of their card by unrelated third parties. This insurance benefit will provide reimbursement of up to USD 3,000 per occurrence with a USD 5,000 annual aggregate limit for Visa Infinite Privilege Cardholders.
